guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Philadelphia this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Philly Holiday Tree at City Hall
items.dates: Lit Dec 3 at 6 PM; through Jan 2
items.addr: 1400 John F Kennedy Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19107
items.blurb: The city's tree outside City Hall, lit at a free celebration on Dec 3.
items.blurbEs: El árbol de la ciudad frente al Ayuntamiento, encendido en una celebración gratis el 3 de diciembre.

items.name: Electrical Spectacle Light Show
items.blurb: Hundreds of thousands of lights choreographed to holiday music, plus mini golf.
items.blurbEs: Cientos de miles de luces coreografiadas con música navideña, además de minigolf.

items.name: LumiNature at the Philadelphia Zoo
items.blurb: Thousands of lights across the zoo, a Santa lodge, seasonal food and live performers.
items.blurbEs: Miles de luces en el zoológico, la cabaña de Santa, comida de temporada y artistas en vivo.

items.name: Boathouse Row Holiday Lights
items.blurb: The famous boathouses glow in colors for Hanukkah, Christmas and Kwanzaa. Best seen from Kelly Drive.
items.blurbEs: Las famosas casas de botes brillan con colores de Janucá, Navidad y Kwanzaa. Mejor desde Kelly Drive.

items.name: Miracle on South 13th Street
items.blurb: A whole block of over-the-top decorated rowhomes in South Philly.
items.blurbEs: Una cuadra entera de casas decoradas a lo grande en el sur de Filadelfia.

items.name: A Longwood Christmas
items.blurb: Outdoor lights, illuminated fountain shows and decorated conservatories.
items.blurbEs: Luces al aire libre, espectáculos de fuentes iluminadas e invernaderos decorados.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in Philadelphia: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Christmas Village in Philadelphia
items.dates: Nov 21–22 preview; Nov 26 – Dec 27 (closed Dec 25); Sun–Thu noon–8, Fri–Sat to 9
items.blurb: An open-air German-style market with 100+ vendors, a Ferris wheel and a carousel.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado alemán al aire libre con más de 100 vendedores, rueda de la fortuna y carrusel.

items.name: Made in Philadelphia Holiday Market
items.blurb: Local artisans, designers and jewelers next to the Dilworth Park rink and Wintergarden.
items.blurbEs: Artesanos, diseñadores y joyeros locales junto a la pista y el jardín de invierno de Dilworth Park.

items.name: Holidays at Peddler's Village
items.blurb: A village of 65+ specialty shops under a million lights, with a gingerbread display.
items.blurbEs: Un pueblo con más de 65 tiendas bajo un millón de luces y una exhibición de casitas de jengibre.
